title: [YSQL] ANALYZE command doesn't populate parent-level stats for partitioned tables
body:
Jira Link: [DB-12511](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-12511)
### Description

Problem
---
* The ANALYZE command doesn't populate the stats for partitioned tables at the top-level.
* Missing parent-level stats leads to poor row count estimates.
* Vanilla PG (even 11) populates the stats with the rows sampled from each partition. **NOTE: vanilla PG populates columns stats but NOT relation stats (`reltuples`, etc.) at the parent-level until upstream commit: pg 0e69f705cc1a3df273b38c9883fb5765991e04fe).  PG15 has this change but not PG11.**

**YB (master: 90554b03): 200 vs. 2500**
```
select version();
                                                             version                                                              
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PostgreSQL 11.2-YB-2.23.1.0-b0 on x86_64-apple-darwin22.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 15.0.0 (clang-1500.1.0.2.5), 64-bit
(1 row)

show yb_enable_base_scans_cost_model;
 yb_enable_base_scans_cost_model 
---------------------------------
 on
(1 row)

-- partitioned
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT a, sum(b) FROM t_part GROUP BY a;

                                                        QUERY PLAN                                                        
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 HashAggregate  (cost=14916.20..14918.20 rows=200 width=12) (actual time=219.861..220.764 rows=2500 loops=1)
   Group Key: t_part1.a
   ->  Append  (cost=180.00..14866.20 rows=10000 width=8) (actual time=48.149..214.338 rows=10000 loops=1)
         ->  Seq Scan on t_part1  (cost=180.00..3688.89 rows=2488 width=8) (actual time=48.146..50.275 rows=2488 loops=1)
         ->  Seq Scan on t_part2  (cost=180.00..3704.05 rows=2500 width=8) (actual time=47.521..49.154 rows=2500 loops=1)
         ->  Seq Scan on t_part3  (cost=180.00..3704.05 rows=2500 width=8) (actual time=53.929..55.625 rows=2500 loops=1)
         ->  Seq Scan on t_part4  (cost=180.00..3719.21 rows=2512 width=8) (actual time=54.938..56.752 rows=2512 loops=1)
 Planning Time: 83.935 ms
 Execution Time: 221.806 ms
 Peak Memory Usage: 0 kB
(10 rows)


-- non-partitioned
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM t_nopart GROUP BY a;

                                                        QUERY PLAN                                                        
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 HashAggregate  (cost=13229.85..13254.85 rows=2500 width=12) (actual time=204.319..205.082 rows=2500 loops=1)
   Group Key: a
   ->  Seq Scan on t_nopart  (cost=180.00..13179.85 rows=10000 width=8) (actual time=190.688..198.073 rows=10000 loops=1)
 Planning Time: 12.337 ms
 Execution Time: 205.631 ms
 Peak Memory Usage: 0 kB
(6 rows)

SELECT starelid, attnum, relname, attname, stadistinct FROM pg_statistic s, pg_class c, pg_attribute a WHERE c.oid = starelid AND c.oid = attrelid AND attnum = staattnum AND relname = 't_part' order by 1, 2;
 starelid | attnum | relname | attname | stadistinct 
----------+--------+---------+---------+-------------
(0 rows)
```

**Vanilla PG11: 2500 vs. 2500**
```
select version();
                                                      version                                                       
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PostgreSQL 11.22 on x86_64-apple-darwin22.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 15.0.0 (clang-1500.1.0.2.5), 64-bit
(1 row)


-- partitioned
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT a, sum(b) FROM t_part GROUP BY a;

                                                        QUERY PLAN                                                        
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HashAggregate  (cost=256.00..281.00 rows=2500 width=12) (actual time=3.753..4.156 rows=2500 loops=1)
   Group Key: t_part1.a
   ->  Append  (cost=0.00..206.00 rows=10000 width=8) (actual time=0.009..2.192 rows=10000 loops=1)
         ->  Seq Scan on t_part1  (cost=0.00..38.88 rows=2488 width=8) (actual time=0.009..0.305 rows=2488 loops=1)
         ->  Seq Scan on t_part2  (cost=0.00..39.00 rows=2500 width=8) (actual time=0.006..0.300 rows=2500 loops=1)
         ->  Seq Scan on t_part3  (cost=0.00..39.00 rows=2500 width=8) (actual time=0.006..0.311 rows=2500 loops=1)
         ->  Seq Scan on t_part4  (cost=0.00..39.12 rows=2512 width=8) (actual time=0.006..0.318 rows=2512 loops=1)
 Planning Time: 1.136 ms
 Execution Time: 4.349 ms
(9 rows)

-- non-partitioned
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM t_nopart GROUP BY a;

                                                        QUERY PLAN                                                        
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HashAggregate  (cost=205.00..230.00 rows=2500 width=12) (actual time=2.557..2.880 rows=2500 loops=1)
   Group Key: a
   ->  Seq Scan on t_nopart  (cost=0.00..155.00 rows=10000 width=8) (actual time=0.007..0.843 rows=10000 loops=1)
 Planning Time: 0.173 ms
 Execution Time: 3.055 ms
(5 rows)

SELECT starelid, attnum, relname, attname, stadistinct FROM pg_statistic s, pg_class c, pg_attribute a WHERE c.oid = starelid AND c.oid = attrelid AND attnum = staattnum AND relname = 't_part' order by 1, 2;
 starelid | attnum | relname | attname | stadistinct 
----------+--------+---------+---------+-------------
    24675 |      1 | t_part  | i       |         800
    24675 |      2 | t_part  | a       |       -0.25
    24675 |      3 | t_part  | b       |       -0.25
(3 rows)
```

Test Case
---
```
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t_part;
CREATE TABLE t_part (i int, a int, b int) PARTITION BY RANGE (i);
CREATE TABLE t_part1 PARTITION OF t_part FOR VALUES FROM (1) TO (200);
CREATE TABLE t_part2 PARTITION OF t_part FOR VALUES FROM (200) TO (400);
CREATE TABLE t_part3 PARTITION OF t_part FOR VALUES FROM (400) TO (600);
CREATE TABLE t_part4 PARTITION OF t_part FOR VALUES FROM (600) TO (MAXVALUE);

INSERT INTO t_part SELECT (i % 200) + 1,   ((i-1) / 4) * 4, i  FROM generate_series(1, 2500) i;
INSERT INTO t_part SELECT (i % 200) + 201, ((i-1) / 4) * 4 + 1, i  FROM generate_series(1, 2500) i;
INSERT INTO t_part SELECT (i % 200) + 401, ((i-1) / 4) * 4 + 2, i  FROM generate_series(1, 2500) i;
INSERT INTO t_part SELECT (i % 200) + 601, ((i-1) / 4) * 4 + 3, i  FROM generate_series(1, 2500) i;


DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t_nopart;
CREATE TABLE t_nopart (i int, a int, b int);
INSERT INTO t_nopart SELECT * FROM t_part;

ANALYZE t_part;
ANALYZE t_nopart;

EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT a, sum(b) FROM t_part GROUP BY a;
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT a, sum(b) FROM t_nopart GROUP BY a;
```
